card.law_is_about: Reducing German air passenger tax from July 2026.
card.they_want: Restore the ETS-linked annual tax abatement mechanism.
card.they_claim: The cited 2019 tax amendment entered force on 1 April 2024.
card.the_problem: It entered force on 1 April 2020; this is a chronology error.

claim_quote.translation_en: Translation: already at the time of entry into force on 1 April 2024

locator.section: Standort durch Senkung der Luftverkehrsteuer stärken

counter_quote.original: Am 1. April 2020 ist das Gesetz zur Änderung des Luftverkehrsteuergesetzes (BGBl. 2019 I S. 2492) in Kraft getreten.
counter_quote.translation_en: Translation: The Act amending the Air Passenger Tax Act (Federal Law Gazette 2019 I, page 2492) entered into force on 1 April 2020.

correction: Replace 2024 with 2020. The official government report confirms both commencement and contemporaneous abatement.
effect: Corrects the history. It does not materially weaken the request for reinstatement.
limits: The adjacent argument that statutory rates were reduced through the previous abatement mechanism remains supported. A clerical year error is a plausible explanation. No intent inferred.
materiality_explanation: Minor: a wrong historical year leaves the described mechanism and comparison of statutory versus effective rates intact.
direction_explanation: No demonstrated favourable argumentative effect; direction is null.
